workflow.title: What you can control
workflow.description: This workflow is designed for prompt-first creation when you want to start from an idea instead of an existing asset.

items.title: Prompt-first generation
items.description: Describe subjects, motion, camera direction, and mood directly in the prompt box.

items.title: Short-form clip lengths
items.description: Choose preset durations from 2 to 15 seconds depending on the scene you want to create.

items.title: 720p and 1080p output
items.description: Pick a faster preview-friendly setting or a sharper export for final delivery.

items.title: Flexible aspect ratios
items.description: Supports 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, and 3:4 for different publishing targets.

items.title: Browser-based workflow
items.description: Stay inside Happy Horse AI instead of switching between separate generation and export tools.

items.title: Credit-based usage
items.description: Start with the plan that fits your output volume and scale up when you need more generation capacity.

items.title: Choose output settings

items.title: Generate and refine

faq.title: Text-to-Video FAQ
faq.description: Questions about the Happy Horse AI prompt-based workflow.

items.question: How is text-to-video different from image-to-video?
items.answer: Text-to-video starts from a written prompt and generates a clip from scratch. Image-to-video starts from a visual asset and focuses on animating or extending that input.

items.question: What settings can I change in text-to-video?
items.answer: You can control duration, output resolution, and aspect ratio before generating the clip.

items.question: What output quality is available?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI currently supports 720p and 1080p output for text-to-video generation.

items.question: When should I use text-to-video?
items.answer: Use it when you want to start from an idea, concept, or script direction rather than a source image or source clip.
